comment: Only two model calls exist for this whole scenario. Turn 1 proposes the create; Esc denies it and ends the turn, so the next call is turn 2 - the user's SECOND message. If the model were called again mid-turn it would take turn 2's slot with the denial as its last user message, and this fixture's mustContain would fail there.

match.comment: 3: [user('make a note'), user(<tool_result> holding the denial), user('second message')]. The stopped turn's empty assistant message is dropped by commitTurn's Mistral-compat guard; the denial itself committed, which is what this count pins.
